nextStep.text: Studio cannot read this spec. See the problem below.

about: The agent goes through the spec with you and adds testable acceptance criteria. Then the spec is challenged and planned.
Any chat: the step reads everything it needs from the files. Strong model: the step reasons over the whole spec or plan.
Choose the chat and the model in your AI assistant before you paste.
Settings (gear in the Specs view): Show Step Tips hides these tips; Model Hints names your models; Assistant opens your AI assistant's chat with the prompt.

lines.intent: Put folder and status back in line
Put folder and status back in line

about: The agent compares folder, status and plan (or both copies of the spec) and proposes the move that brings them in line. You confirm the move; the Studio follows the files.
Any chat: the step reads everything it needs from the files. Fast model: one small, well-described step.
Choose the chat and the model in your AI assistant before you paste.
Settings (gear in the Specs view): Show Step Tips hides these tips; Model Hints names your models; Assistant opens your AI assistant's chat with the prompt.
